# raydium-amm-decoder

> Offline Raydium v4 AMM account decoder (AmmInfo, 752 bytes) — browser and Node, no RPC.

- Site: https://visawestern.github.io/raydium-amm-decoder/
- Static demo, no backend. Open index.html in a browser.
- License: see LICENSE. Source: https://github.com/visawestern/raydium-amm-decoder
